zh.explain: 你可以高挂船帆，在五湖四海自由航行。如果获得顺风相送，便能很快达到目的，收获满船财宝满心欢喜。
divination: 逍遥自在，悠闲惬意，用不着劳心费力，即可获得财源滚滚。
items: 与人和善、顺势而为则顺心如意
zh.summary: 此卦顺风撑船之象。所祈求之事皆顺利吉祥。

verse: Sail as you please, across the world’s lakes and oceans,
With sails hoisted high, the ship moves on.
A good wind will soon herald its arrival,
A ship’s hull fills with troves of treasures.
interpretation: A life of ease and comfort.  A lot of wealth will come to you even with minimum effort.  This is an enviable position.
meaning: A ship sailing with a favorable wind.
Everything will turn out well and be fortuitous.
en.explain: You can sail at ease to any part of the world in a high-hoisted sail. If wind conditions are favourable, you will reach your goal speedily and gain a ship full of treasures with great joy.
divination: Life is carefree and relax, you will get a lot of wealth without any effort, everything goes well and joyful for you.
items: Favorable in later half of year
Be kind and go with the flow, you will have what you wish.
Give full play to your strengths and you will have good results

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh 祖坟牌位 says 向南方位 (south) but en says 'Favorable if in the West' — copied as printed.
